profile.headline: Student at University of Colorado in Boulder | BS in Computer Science | BA in Mathematics
profile.summary: A proactive BSc in Computer Science and BA in Mathematics student at the University of Colorado, Boulder, with strong academic achievements and experience across various industries. I have solid technical expertise, particularly in C++ and Python, along with strong leadership and communication skills. I am fluent in English, with Spanish as my native language

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Developed an automated oscilloscope testing program for an analog-to-digital board, integrating socket communication protocols to synchronize hardware components, reducing test execution from hours to under 30 seconds.
• Integrated hardware and software systems including function generators, test boards, and motorized optical devices, applying concurrency and packet structures to increase robustness of aerospace testing workflows.
• Engineered real-time hardware control software for a coelostat, combining Python multithreading, a PID controller, and computer vision. Achieved sub-second response and continuous laser alignment within 1.5°.
• Developed interactive control interfaces for the coelostat, enabling customers to operate and monitor the system directly, improving accessibility and user interaction with complex hardware.
positions.insights: Internet Software, Embedded Systems and +2 skills

positions.title: Algorithm development for atmospheric and cryopsheric satellite data analysis.
positions.description:
• Worked with DDA algorithm for detecting faint aerosols in CALIPSO and ICESat-2 satellite lidar data, while collaborating in a multi-programmer environment and learning to handle large-scale coding projects.

• Developed advanced mathematical algorithms utilizing complex linear algebra techniques, implementing performance-critical components in C++ and supplementary functionality in Python.

• Development, test and optimization of complex algorithms to process and interpolate large volumes of data from NASA satellites, improving computational speed by over 90% compared to the previous algorithm.
positions.insights: Linear Algebra, Python (Programming Language) and +12 skills

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description:
• Troubleshooting software and hardware incidents for more than 20 customers per week.

• Coordinated software and hardware purchases, installations, and configurations, improving my communication skills by effectively identifying customer requirements and limitations.
positions.insights: Software Troubleshooting, Customer Service and +8 skills

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
* Volunteered as a guide for blind and disabled skiers with the non-profit organization ’Guías Club Siempre,’ developing strong communication skills during the experience.
* Guided the Spanish skier champion of the absolute female category.
